description: One Framing C image for each desk-frame segment on the william journal's three packed days (2025-08-10, 2025-10-22, 2025-12-30). Each shot names the timed frame chosen as that segment's picture. Framing C was chosen on 2026-11-17.

framings.name: Framing C · 2025 ProRAW Sensor (True Available Light, Zero HDR Shadow-Lift)
framings.instruction: Captured as an ungraded 2025 ProRAW digital photograph using only honest that year available light, with zero computational HDR shadow-lifting or stylized color grading. In low light, candlelight, or dusk, shadows fall into deep natural darkness and flames hold warm highlight roll-off without night-mode brightening; in daylight, contrast is crisp and unvarnished. Gritty, lived-in that year documentary realism—mud, coal soot, worn working cloth, damp stone, and uneven hand-built surfaces, caught mid-moment from a 5 ft 7 in eye level with nobody posing. No sepia, no antique filter, no film grain, no vignette, no painting style, no added signs or legible lettering, and nothing modern in the frame. Guards from the sample round: no added signs or legible lettering anywhere (no play titles, shop signs, banners, book titles, or printed words; any writing is illegible cursive or smudged black-letter only). Do not show the photographer's hand, arm, or anything he is carrying unless the subject text explicitly puts his own hand in the frame; if it does, that hand only, with no face and no reflection. No modern background details: no skyline blocks, no glass street lamps, no cast-iron downpipes, no tattoo-like smudges. Clean bare skin. Nothing aged, sepia, grained, vignetted, or painted.
